what_happened: Dispatch FILE SCOPE named EXTENSION.md but omitted README.md; check-extension-docs.sh's check_readme_vs_manifest() requires the new /sapience command name to also appear textually in README.md, which currently states outright that the extension has no slash command. Flagged in the research report's Decisions section as an addition to the plan's file scope.

Research found the command needs zero Agent-tool subagent dispatch: skill-literature's fully-direct-execution shape (Bash/Read/Write/Edit/AskUserQuestion, no Agent) covers the whole /sapience workflow, which sidesteps the AskUserQuestion tool-withholding hazard entirely rather than working around it the way skill-roadmap/skill-meta do. Also found the four candidate write surfaces fit exactly under AskUserQuestion's 4-option ceiling, so no task-581 batching/tiering machinery is needed.

EXTENSION.md measured exactly 60 lines, precisely at check-extension-docs.sh Rule U's 60-line ceiling with zero slack. The dispatch FILE SCOPE said 'document the command' in EXTENSION.md, which would fail the gate on any net line addition. Plan Phase 5 now requires an in-place replacement of the existing 'no slash command' paragraph with net line delta <= 0.

The dispatch FILE SCOPE named EXTENSION.md but not README.md, although check-extension-docs.sh's check_readme_vs_manifest() hard-fails when a provides.commands entry is not textually mentioned as /<name> in that extension's README.md. Research flagged it; the plan adds README.md plus agent-system/extensions/README.md to Phase 5.

validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification suite-claim check caught four defective justifications at plan-acceptance time: one fabricated suite claim where suite_selection_select actually returns __FULL_SWEEP__, and three under-verifying claims naming a subset of the selector's output. Also caught a comma-joined backtick path in a Files to modify entry. All five fixed before the plan closed; final validation is 0 warnings.

The dispatch's load-bearing constraint (picker must run before any agent dispatch, because AskUserQuestion is withheld from named-subagent_type dispatches) dissolved entirely: no Agent-tool dispatch is needed anywhere, so skill-sapience follows skill-literature's fully-direct shape rather than skill-roadmap's pre-delegation-then-dispatch shape. Also confirmed no fifth script is needed - the publishers' own dry-run print is the literal-payload mechanism.
